name: graph
description: Shortest-path and heuristic-search algorithms for boru (Dijkstra, A*, Floyd-Warshall, Bellman-Ford), to be exposed as the single `Graph` namespace. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: graph.aql exports an empty namespace. The argued design is in DESIGN.md.

conventions.call: forward args, receiver (the graph) LAST: `Graph.verb ...args g`. Piping `g Graph.verb ...args end` binds identically; only receiver-first-all-forward misbinds.
conventions.heuristic: A heuristic passed to Graph.astar must be SELF-CONTAINED (parameters and builtins only). boru resolves a function value's free words in the module that RUNS it, so a heuristic calling the caller's own helper raises undefined_word. See DESIGN.md section 7.
conventions.nodes: Node names are Strings: boru map keys must be String or Atom.
conventions.representation: Weighted adjacency map, {node: {neighbour: weight}}. `{a: {b: 3}}` is an edge a->b of weight 3. Isolated nodes are representable as `{a: {}}`.
conventions.unreachable: Unreachable nodes are ABSENT from the result, never an infinity sentinel (boru raises a hard error on 63-bit integer overflow).
